subject: Proposal: Staggered MAP check-ins to accommodate EMEA & APAC stakeholders
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@acme-analytics.com>, Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: Staggered MAP check-ins to accommodate EMEA & APAC stakeholders

Hi Claire & Emma —

Following last week’s demo, we want to keep MAP momentum without forcing one global time that stretches participation. Proposal below is a lightweight approach to preserve continuity for the evaluation and keep owners aligned: 

- Weekly MAP checkpoints split into two 30-min slots: EMEA-friendly (09:30–10:00 CET) and APAC-friendly (16:30–17:00 SGT). Same agenda, different attendees (overlap will include the PM and AE).
- Agenda (fixed, 30 min): 1) 10m status / blockers, 2) 10m eval results & actions, 3) 10m next actions + owners.
- Rotate the meeting owner weekly between Acme (Claire/Emma) and Redwood (Marissa/Karthik) to keep accountability visible.
- We’ll maintain a single MAP spreadsheet (attached draft v3) and an eval checklist PDF for reference.

Why this helps: short focused calls keep the cadence and reduce churn from time-zone swaps, while allowing the right subject-matter experts to attend their local slot. We can consolidate notes to the Drive folder and surface a single action list.

Ask: can you confirm which attendees prefer which slot and whether Claire or Emma should be the primary Acme owner for the next 3 weeks? If you’re ok, I’ll send two recurring calendar invites with a single shared agenda link and a short note about rotating owners.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_draft_Acme_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB), eval_checklist_Acme.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@acme-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposal: Staggered MAP check-ins to accommodate EMEA & APAC stakeholders

Thanks Soojin — this makes sense. Emma and I will split coverage: Emma will take the EMEA slot (09:30–10:00 CET) and I’ll try the APAC-friendly slot the first week to observe; if timing becomes awkward I’ll switch to the EMEA slot as well.

Primary owner: Claire Hsu (me) for week 1, then we’ll hand off to Emma week 2. Please mark both of us as optional in the invites until we lock the rotation.

A couple of notes on the MAP draft: I added a target completion date for the evaluation infra (end of the month) and a row for the procurement checklist. I also flagged model quantization as a risk that needs more detail — happy to discuss on the call.

—Claire

On attachments: I’ve uploaded our internal procurement template to the shared Drive (see link).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@acme-analytics.com>, Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: Staggered MAP check-ins to accommodate EMEA & APAC stakeholders

Great — thanks Claire. I’ll spin up two recurring calendar events: 'MAP checkpoint — EMEA' and 'MAP checkpoint — APAC'. Both will reference the single Drive agenda and include the same meeting notes doc. Can everyone confirm their status for these times by EOD Friday?

Dylan, Karthik: can you both confirm who will represent Redwood in each slot for the next three weeks? Our ask is that at least one product owner or engineer be present on the EMEA slot for technical clarifications.

I’ll also add a short line to each invite describing the weekly owner rotation and the escalation contact if procurement questions surface.

—Marissa

I can take the EMEA slot for the next three weeks (09:30–10:00 CET). I’ll bring our infra checklist and be prepared to run through the quantization risks Claire flagged. If Emma wants deeper infra review, we can add an ad-hoc 20-min deep-dive the following day.

Also, small scheduling ask: can the EMEA slot be on Tuesdays instead of Mondays? We have an internal deployment window most Mondays that sometimes eats into our availability. If folks prefer Monday for Acme, we can keep it — just flagging potential conflict.

Dylan

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps (I’ll post these to the shared notes doc as well):

- Confirmed cadence: Weekly MAP checkpoints, two 30-min slots (EMEA: Tue 09:30–10:00 CET; APAC: Wed 16:30–17:00 SGT) — starting week of Feb 23.
- Owners: Week 1 owner (Feb 24 EMEA slot): Dylan Brooks (Redwood). Week 1 APAC slot owner (Feb 25): Claire Hsu (Acme). We’ll rotate thereafter per the calendar notes.
- Action items: 1) Claire to add procurement contacts to the MAP (Claire) — due Feb 20; 2) Dylan to produce a short quantization risk summary (Redwood) — due Feb 22; 3) Marissa to publish invites & shared agenda (Redwood) — done by Feb 18.
- Artifacts: MAP_draft_Acme_v3.xlsx (master), eval_checklist_Acme.pdf; HubSpot deal and shared Drive link live.

If nobody objects, Marissa — please create the recurring invites and mark Claire/Emma optional for the APAC/EMEA slots as discussed.

Karthik
